# ELITEA-0152: Chat — Messages from unpublished agent: delete succeeds, regenerate returns expected error

**Module:** Agents Publishing · **Priority:** Medium · **Type:** Functional

**Objective:** Verify that messages previously generated by an agent that is now unpublished can be deleted without errors, but attempting to regenerate such a message returns an expected error.

**Coverage:**
- Deleting a message produced by a now-unpublished agent works correctly with no errors
- Regenerating a message produced by a now-unpublished agent returns an error (expected behavior — agent unavailable)
- Original message is preserved after a failed regeneration

## Preconditions

- Logged in to {{base_url}}
- Agent "Test Publishing" has been unpublished (any scenario)
- Existing conversation has at least 2 agent-generated messages

## Test Data

- Agent name: "Test Publishing"
- Two agent-generated messages needed: one for deletion, one for regeneration attempt

## Steps

| # | Action | Expected Result |
|---|--------|----------------|
| 1 | Open the conversation. Find an agent-generated message to reveal action options. | Message action options appear (delete, regenerate, etc.). |
| 2 | Click Delete on the message and confirm. | Message is removed cleanly. No error toast appears. All other messages are unaffected. |
| 3 | Find  a second agent-generated message. Click Regenerate. | An error is returned indicating the agent is unavailable. The original message remains in the chat. |
| 4 | Verify the original message that failed to regenerate is still shown. | Original message is intact in the conversation. |

## Expected Final State

Original message is intact in the conversation.

## Pass/Fail Criteria

**Pass:**
- Delete removes the message cleanly with no error toast
- Regenerate returns an error indicating agent is unavailable
- Original message preserved after failed regeneration

**Fail:**
- Delete throws an error or the message reappears after deletion
- Regeneration silently succeeds using a wrong or stale version
- Original message lost after failed regeneration
